purpose: A one-call, six-task pilot of CONFIG/CODE/HYBRID selection over actually runnable Saltcorn native mechanisms

platform_capabilities.data_model: Saltcorn Table/Field can store String and Integer fields and render a native List View without custom JavaScript
platform_capabilities.code_action: Existing workflow capabilities lack a declarative modulo-7 checksum rule, but allow a custom run_js_code Validate Trigger
platform_capabilities.hybrid: A native schema can hold approval_note and Key relation while an Insert Trigger performs a cross-table threshold audit snapshot
platform_capabilities.deployment: Only preinstalled reviewed native Pack/Trigger adapters are allowed; model CANNOT supply or execute arbitrary JS, shell, or SQL
platform_capabilities.limits: No claim these platform capabilities exhaust all Saltcorn plugins or are universal impossibility proofs

cases.requirement: 合同登记需要新增一个普通文本‘业务联系人备注’，保存后在合同列表展示即可；已有字段与列表组件可以覆盖，不要求计算规则。
新增‘归档说明’文本信息，要求录入、保存并显示在现有列表中，除了基本字段保存无额外行为。
业务编号采用 K-数字-末位码 格式，末位必须等于前面的整数对 7 取模。现有字段配置仅有基础长度/必填校验，字段结构不需要变化。
另一个合同编号同样要执行自定义模 7 校验（如 K-22-1），现有规则配置不支持该算法，不能用纯文本保存代替校验。
合同增加可录入的‘审批备注’，保存时若金额严格超过 100 万元，要把备注与审核档位同步快照到关联审计记录。需要持久字段和当前未提供的跨表条件行为。
合同增加‘复核备注’作为业务模型字段；在登记时需要自定义动作将该备注与金额档位写入另一张关联表，金额恰好 100 万元不应升级审批。

scorer: Six exact mode matches and independent native Saltcorn SQLite/HTML proof, not grading by model self-explanation
coverage_limits: Small hand-curated fixture set; no measured generalization or reproducibility variance
Only preimplemented Saltcorn field, code trigger and combined trigger capabilities
No generated code, no autonomous tool implementation or real human-agent editing
